description: w1_v15stack_race44.py functions as the experimental challenger continuation, built on the v15 stack but modified with the 'race44' behavioral variant. Designed to be injected at mid-game checkpoints during counterfactual state rollouts, it executes this variant against frozen opponent tapes. The harness measures the exact delta in terminal reward between the control logic and the race44 optimization, providing ground-truth comparison labels to train the macro-selector model.

w0_v15stack_control.py serves as the baseline control continuation within the counterfactual evaluation harness. Utilizing the stable v15 stack architecture, it executes deterministic macro-strategies from frozen environment checkpoints. This agent provides the control metric for candidate rollout comparisons, ensuring that experimental continuations are evaluated against a rigorously standardized baseline under identical seed, seat, and opponent transition dynamics
